semantic.scope: all 54 LIVE_BOTH features (ZERO_AT_SERVE 15 classified in FEATURE_PROVENANCE.md finding 1; odds family in finding 2)

classes.PRE_RACE_SAFE: race-card facts knowable before the race
classes.PRIOR_STARTS_ONLY: prior starts/trials strictly before race date (as-of safe)
classes.SP_DERIVED: derived from the starting price of the race being predicted
classes.RESULT_DERIVED_LEAK: train-side: derivation includes the subject race's own result or later races (serve may still be safe)
classes.CONSTANT_AT_TRAIN: assigned but zero-variance at train (placeholder/dead parent)

barrier_x_pace_inv.note: FINDING 6c: barrier_advantage never assigned at train -> product identically 0

campaign_run_number.note: prior-run gaps <=60d — inherits finding 6a via is_first_up reset

class_movement.note: current class (card fact) - mean(last-3 prior class)

course_strike_rate.note: prior runs at same track, >=5 runs

days_since_run.note: FINDING 6a: uses pd.Timestamp.now() not race_date (:98) — train values corrupted for historical rows

fitness_x_distance.note: campaign proxy x distance_strike_rate — inherits finding 6a via campaign_run_number

going_suitability.note: prior runs on same going bucket; current going is a card fact

is_bounce_candidate.note: prior-run perf vs career best, >=5 priors

is_first_time_stakes.note: FINDING 6c: hardcoded 0, no other train assignment

is_second_up.note: prior-run gaps — inherits finding 6a wall-clock defect

is_winning_combo.note: any prior win with current jockey on this horse

jockey_booking_change.note: current booking vs last-start jockey; win rates < month-start (:867)

jockey_trainer_strike_rate.note: prior rides of THIS horse by current jockey (name misleading; no trainer)

market_odds.note: filled from sp_odds of the race being predicted (finding 2)

runs_since_peak.note: index of career-best prior run; NaN-preserved

sectional_rank_at_distance.note: PERCENT_RANK within prior races; ranks < race_date (ffb:1097-1099)

td_barrier_style_edge.note: constant 0 at train; parent aggregate carries finding-5 leak when populated at serve

td_closing_speed_bias.note: FINDING 5: winners' last-200m aggregate includes subject race's winner

td_pace_bias.note: FINDING 5: train-side aggregate leak — window has no upper bound, includes subject race + post-race results to build date; serve-safe

td_upset_rate.note: FINDING 5: same aggregate leak (SP-ranked upset groups include subject race)

trainer_momentum_score.note: FINDING 6b: constant 50 at train; only mc_api computes it live (mc_api.py:5852-5853, as-of safe)

trainer_trial_pattern.note: post-trial win rate; monthly cutoff < month-start

trial_x_experience.note: best trial pos pct / career starts
